Name: Sir Robert's Tabletop Plants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][u][b]Features and Options:[/b][/u]

This is a collection of 10 slightly SMALLER potted plants that I've modified with pots from my previous mod. Each plant has Alternative Textures so you can select a different pot that will compliment your color palette. Truth be told, I LOVE to have lots of options and my mods will allow you to have large, medium AND small houseplants to decorate to your heart's desire. Next up I will either attempt extra-large plants...or perhaps plants in small vases.

If you're a long-time player of Stardew Valley, you will know that houseplants don't always align perfectly on tabletops, which makes me very sad because I like things to be centered! Therefore, I made a few Alternative Textures of each plant to be a slightly different alignment, so that they can be placed with some of my favorite tabletops. For example, I absolutely love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]kitchen cabinets[/url] by lululovely, but alas...the placement of my plants were too close to the edge & looked funny. So I moved them up a few pixels and now they look perfect.  I wish I could match them with everything, but that would clutter up the Furniture Catalog with multiple images of the same plant...

Please note: none of the chairside tables and nightstands shown in the pictures were made by me! They are all from catalogs in the Stardew Valley game and I also used furniture from mods by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lululovely/mods]lululovely[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7/mods]Orangeblossom7[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18490]twinkle22[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36809]Pixie's MCM Bedroom Furniture[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43300]Creamy Cozy Decor by ENGloomy[/url]. 

[size=4]All you have to do is unzip the download folder directly into Stardew Valley/Mods - the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures files will be in the same folder for your convenience. When you open the game, the 10 images will be clumped together [size=4]under the "Decor/Houseplant" section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer. Each image will have a variety of Alternative Textures to select from.[/size]

[size=4][u][b]Installation and Usage:[/b][/u][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=4]Install the latest verson of SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ are not required, but I do recommend them. Precise Furniture is great if you want to place the plant on the floor & move it pixel by pixel. However, it doesn't work once you place the plant on a tabletop. [/size]
[*][size=4]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier.[/size]
[/list][/size][/size][/font]
